scope: claim-local wording only; corrections supersede named aspirational fragments without deleting historical text

rows.current_wording: For prime editing, selection returns constant PBS=13 and RTT=16 lengths, with no reverse-transcriptase template sequence or thermodynamic optimization.
Mutation pipeline chains four scalar heuristic nodes for three embedded genes. It does not couple spatial/time scales or execute SBML, FBA or docking models.
Compiler serializes supplied question/result and generic replay instructions. No notebook, executable code, recorded arguments or runtime environment is emitted.
json.dumps is used without a schema validator or a strict JSON configuration; schema_version is a string label, not schema enforcement.
Monte Carlo multiplies independently sampled Gaussian node values. Mutation output labels data sparsity medium; neither method infers regions of epistemic uncertainty.
Mutation result always suggests the same three experiment families, including a catalog pathway reporter. No pathway perturbation is selected or simulated to resolve uncertainty.
No information-gain objective, posterior experiment simulation, candidate comparison or maximization exists. Feedback suggests replicates based on total pseudo-counts.
Standalone Beta-binomial feedback returns new counts/mean. Prediction functions do not consume that state and no durable update loop is wired.

rows.exact_historical_claim: optimizes the process of discovering answers
rows.current_wording: Question handling uses keyword routes, gene-catalog responses or PubMed record retrieval. No search-policy learning, outcome-driven discovery optimization or experiment execution occurs.
Wizard combines embedded product/chassis catalog, weighted scores, GC/diversity proxy, dinucleotide energy surrogate and serial-pathway LP. It has no demonstrated comprehensive biological validation.
Assembly helper returns a method/standard name and explicitly says architecture only. No validated procedures, laboratory control or execution protocol is produced.
Catalog parameters and design pipeline are fixed. Feedback is a separately invoked count update, not modification of models, code or objectives.
logic_circuit evaluates Boolean AND/OR/NOT and returns an implementation label. Broader wizard composes catalog/surrogate helpers, not a full-stack biological intelligence system.
Manual successes/total updates change caller-carried Beta parameters. There is no persistent learning service or feedback consumption by chassis/flux/yield predictions.
Boolean circuit evaluator and project aggregator run. parts_max is not enforced against generated part count, so project output is not a constraint-valid biological compiler.
cai_proxy depends on total GC deviation from a chassis target and codon diversity. It does not compute geometric-mean relative synonymous-codon adaptiveness from host usage tables.
RBS energy adds dinucleotide GC/CG and AU/UA counts to a constant and converts this to accessibility. No RNA folding ensemble or ribosome-binding thermodynamics is solved.
deterministic_expression solves a fixed two-state mRNA/protein ODE. This is not a biology programming language or genetic-code compiler.
Boolean circuit evaluation, forward guide enumeration, codon proxy and plasmid module labels are produced. No complete DNA construct or laboratory-executable artifact is compiled.

rows.exact_historical_claim: off-target prediction via mismatch tolerance scoring and seed-region specificity
rows.current_wording: an off-target proxy score from guide GC and seed-region nucleotide diversity (no mismatch scoring, no genome search)
a variant module maps a user-supplied conservation score to a heuristic ΔΔG and applies an active-site flag (no protein structure is predicted or used)
flux_balance solves a serial-pathway SciPy HiGHS LP under uptake and aggregate ATP/redox inequalities. No stoichiometric equality matrix or COBRA metabolic network is loaded.
an SBML-style XML export is written (it fails libsbml checks for SBML L3V2)
a single burden-minus-selection term (there is no fitness landscape)
knowledge_graph rebuilds nodes/edges from an embedded fixed product catalog. environment_response is a standalone formula; there is no graph persistence or publication update stream.
seeded runs repeat numerically but nothing here ensures lab reproducibility

uncertainty_distribution reports normal-sampling 5th/95th quantiles as ci90; run_wizard reports 5th/195th sorted values of 200 simulated draws with a corrected approximate-95% label. Neither is fitted confidence coverage.
epistemic_fraction is defined as 1/sqrt(data_n), and project uncertainty labels are derived from catalog difficulty. No identifiable epistemic/aleatoric decomposition is fitted.
suggest_experiments ranks supplied uncertainty numbers and returns domain templates; expected_information_gain is uncertainty times sensitivity, not predicted posterior reduction.
Sampling and a sample-count proxy produce intervals but no calibration, out-of-distribution rejection or overconfidence evaluation exists.
suggest_experiments returns short domain-template descriptions. No experiments are conducted, ingested automatically or evaluated against hypothesis acceptance criteria.
feedback_posterior computes a supplied-count Beta posterior; compile_project uses fixed catalog/surrogate formulas and does not consume that feedback. Predictive accuracy has not been validated.
Project compiler aggregates deterministic/seeded helpers without verified model correctness, recorded environment manifest or laboratory replication. Statistical feedback is manual.
MLP training, lesions, modality projections and continual_update are callable helpers. pipeline_report invokes a fixed sequence once; no recurring feedback-to-training orchestration exists.
NumPy two-layer MLP, sequence encoders, numeric analysis and spiking simulation exist. No symbolic rule engine, production MLOps registry/deployment or neuro-symbolic integration is provided.
Model is a two-layer tanh/sigmoid MLP trained on synthetic toy or caller-supplied DNA labels. Biological authenticity/generalization is not established by its architecture.
Implementation includes simple MLP/lesion/RSA/SVD/LIF-style helpers, without an independent current neuroscience benchmark or validated biological comparison.
predictive_coding iteratively moves a zero state toward the mean of supplied observations. It has no hierarchy, generative dynamics or future predictive task.
continual_update pulls W1/W2 toward previous weights without Fisher information; biases are not anchored and no old-task retention guarantee is checked.

rows.exact_historical_claim: A defining feature would be its ability to map internal model representations to interpretable neurobiological analogues.
rows.current_wording: rsa compares input/hidden Euclidean dissimilarities, align_modalities projects each modality separately, and connectivity uses model weights. No brain correspondence dataset or neurobiological interpretation is validated.
functional_connectivity thresholds products of W1 and W2 magnitudes into input-to-hidden edges. It does not ingest brain connectivity measurements.
rsa correlates upper triangles of input and hidden Euclidean-distance matrices. It does not learn an alignment transformation or pair manifolds.

rows.exact_historical_claim: This would push explainability from visualization into mechanistic insight.
rows.current_wording: RSA geometry correlation, feature clamping and lesion accuracy drops describe numerical model sensitivity. They do not establish a biological mechanism or validated mechanistic explanation.
activation_trace records magnitudes from one feedforward pass; lesion_study reports accuracy deltas and causal_intervention reports output changes. These functions have no temporal trajectory.
The cited activation trace contains layer magnitudes, not neural spike sequences. Separate spiking_dynamics simulates threshold/decay voltage and spikes but is not wired to MLP inference.
causal_intervention replaces one input column with a constant and forwards the MLP. It has no structural causal model, confounding graph or do-calculus identification.
The reported average_causal_effect is mean prediction change after feature clamping. It is a model sensitivity result, not causally identified biological or observational effect.
feedback_reward_update returns Beta count statistics for supplied outcomes; it never updates model weights, chooses experiments or controls an autonomous loop.
Reward update is generic count arithmetic with no biological variables, external evidence or learned biological mechanism.
Beta update does not model brain circuits, plasticity mechanisms or adaptive cognition. No trained adaptive biological intelligence is produced.
Reward helper returns reward mean/standard deviation; pipeline_report does not apply these values to its trained MLP or evaluate an accuracy improvement.
Cited reward function is a generic Beta update; neuroscience-inspired helpers elsewhere do not turn this update into a neuroscience-driven autonomous research system.
No autonomous experiment selection, lab execution, biological discovery validation or publication-feedback runtime is implemented.

BioGPT Lit uses regex tokenization with relation-word dictionary lookup, in-memory triples, heuristic evidence weights, graph traversal and hypothesis templates. No trained reasoning model or autonomous scientific reasoning is bundled.

rows.exact_historical_claim: living, multi-layered representation of biological knowledge
rows.current_wording: Graph stores claims/metadata in process memory. Updates require manual ingestion; there is no persistent living graph, semantic multi-layer model or continuous indexing service.
